snippet.title: Despertar Trailer
snippet.description:
Pending release on STEAM

The game was developed in Spanish and then translated to English, you can choose what language to use from the tittle screen or in the option menu.

Explore a top-down world where danger lurks around every corner and every decision matters.

You play as a protagonist suddenly thrown into an unfamiliar realm—far from home and closer than ever to the source of the mysterious virus. As you journey forward, you’ll encounter allies who join your cause, each helping you push deeper into the unknown.

Combat features classic side-view, turn-based battles, where strategy and preparation are key to survival. Choose your actions carefully, manage your party, and overcome increasingly dangerous enemies as you approach the truth.
